instruction: I find dense information easier to manage when it is simplified and saved as a persistent reference. Read the local SELF hydration guide PDF in Microsoft Edge and copy its road and trail running hydration-system advice exactly into Sticky Notes.
gt_steps: Open the local PDF snapshot in Microsoft Edge.
Open the SELF hydration article in Microsoft Edge.
Locate the road and trail running hydration-system guidance in the `Type of Activity` section.

Enter exactly `For anything like road and trail running, you’ll want a system that keeps your water and gear close to your body to cut down on bouncing. In that case, most runners opt for vests and belts.` in the note.

points: For anything like road and trail running, you’ll want a system that keeps your water and gear close to your body to cut down on bouncing. In that case, most runners opt for vests and belts.
